notes: Hand-authored, not derived. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root; tests/** excluded. src/server/services/webhook-service.ts (createWebhook) makes the refusal: countEndpoints, then wouldExceedLimit, then throw. src/config/plan-limits.ts declares the per-plan `webhooks` number and the wouldExceedLimit comparison itself — the prompt asks for both the decision and the declared number. EXCLUDED: src/actions/webhooks/create-webhook.ts (Server Action wrapper with no quota arithmetic of its own); src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/webhooks/page.tsx and .../webhook-manager.tsx (display the cap, never enforce it); src/server/repositories/webhook-repository.ts (counts rows, does not compare them to anything).
